end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using groups of ten as a guide.
Ananya described an estimate as a nearby number, such as 39 or 41 for 40.
They identified that the first group had ten items and discussed “close” and “near.”
They did not complete the teach-back; one of two attempts was unaided correct.
No misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group of ten to estimate a larger collection. Ananya used nearby numbers to explain an estimate and identified ten items in the first group. They asked for a different activity when the question was repeated, so at home you can use a small set of objects and ask for one estimate, then count to check it.
